billingCategory.title: Billing Category
billingCategory.summary: Structured billing classification for time entries (declarabel / niet-declarabel / intern / WBSO / DBA).
billingCategory.description: A billingCategory provides the controlled vocabulary for classifying time entries. Replaces free-text tagging with consistent, reportable categories. Supports Dutch compliance flags: requiresWbsoRef for WBSO/RVO hour administration and isDba for Wet DBA contractor classification. Referenced by timeEntry.billingCategory (slug or UUID). REQ-BCT-001.

name.description: Display name of the category (e.g. Declarabel, WBSO O&O).
name.title: Name

code.description: Short machine-readable identifier (e.g. BILL, WBSO, DBA). Should be unique per active category.
code.title: Code

type.description: Classification type: billable, non-billable, or internal.
type.title: Type

color.description: Hex color code (e.g. #28a745) used for badges and dashboard chart segments.
color.title: Color

description.description: Explanation of when this category should be applied.
description.title: Description

isDefault.description: When true this category is pre-selected on new time entries. At most one active category should carry this flag.
isDefault.title: Is Default

requiresWbsoRef.description: When true, time entries in this category MUST carry a WBSO project reference for RVO submissions. REQ-BCT-003.
requiresWbsoRef.title: Requires Wbso Ref

isDba.description: When true, marks hours as ZZP/DBA contractor work for Wet DBA tax compliance. REQ-BCT-005.
isDba.title: Is Dba

isActive.description: When true the category is available for selection on new time entries. Deactivated categories remain visible in the management list.
isActive.title: Is Active

objects.name: Declarabel
objects.description: Uren die rechtstreeks aan de klant worden gefactureerd op basis van het afgesproken uurtarief of vaste prijs.

objects.name: Niet-declarabel
objects.description: Uren die intern worden gedragen en niet aan de klant worden doorbelast. Bijvoorbeeld: offertebegeleiding, interne overleggen, garantiewerk.

objects.name: Intern
objects.description: Interne overhead-uren: teamvergaderingen, administratie, opleidingen, verlof en ziekteverlof.

objects.name: WBSO O&O
objects.description: Speur- en ontwikkelingswerk (S&O) dat kwalificeert voor WBSO-tegemoetkoming via de RVO. Vereist een WBSO-projectreferentie op de tijdregel.

objects.name: DBA Opdracht
objects.description: Uren gewerkt door zelfstandige opdrachtnemers (ZZP) in het kader van de Wet DBA. Wordt apart gerapporteerd voor belastingcompliance.
